name: midcentury
summary: 1950s-60s magazine illustration with stylised, expressive figures and a touch of drama. Suits every story.
prompt: Mid-century modern magazine illustration from the 1950s and 60s: stylised elongated figures, simplified geometric shapes, dry-brush and crayon textures on warm paper, witty dramatic staging and clean composition, like vintage Saturday Evening Post or Fortune illustrations redone today, in a limited palette of the given colours plus neutrals.
